ObjectName.value: Gas Lamp plaque - Maruyama Park Maruyamacho Higashiyama Ward Kyoto 605-0071 Japan

Categories.value: CC-Zero|Maruyama Park (Kyoto)|Self-published work|Plaques with known Open Plaques IDs|Kyoto photographs taken on 2025-09-06

ImageDescription.value: "Gas Lamp. Around 1874–1875, gas lamps were introduced to the streets of Kyoto. This particular lamp is one of the finest and most significant examples of early gas lamps still in existence in Japan. It is a reconstruction based on precise measurements of an original lamp—manufactured in London, England, and once used as a street lamp in the foreign settlement of Kobe. Commemorating the Meiji Centennial. Donated in 1967 by the Kyoto Tachibana Lions Club."
